bio.text: Amanda Janoo advanced from the Democratic primary for Governor of Vermont on August 11, 2026, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot.
According to her campaign website, she was born in rural Vermont, raised in South Strafford, and now rents an apartment in Burlington.
She received a bachelor's degree from Macalester College in 2010 and a master of philosophy from the University of Cambridge in 2013.

She is economics and policy lead for the Wellbeing Economy Alliance and, according to her campaign website, began her career working with the United Nations and international development organizations.
